info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to shed tears,to cry,to weep,to lament

entries.artha_hindi: ro rokara SAMta karanA, dUsare ke lie ronA

examples: 'na garBasTaH praroditi' (suSrute 1.319). uBayatra praSabdo na DAtvarTaM viSinazwi.
'aTAkasmAtpravavfte tayA sADvyA praroditum' (kaTA॰10.36). praSabdaH prakarze. sA sADvI uccEH krandituM pravfttetyarTaH.
'avakzutamavaruditaM taTA SrAdDe ca varjayet' (BA0 anu0 91.41). yasyopari aSrURi patitAni tad (annam) avaruditamucyate.
'gadyapadyamayI rAjastutirvirudamucyate' (sA0 da0 570). tasyedamudAharaRam--nadanti madadantinaH parilasanti vAjivrajAH. paWanti virudAvalImahitamandire vandinaH (rasagaM0).
'upArurodeva nadatpataNgaH kumudvatIM tIratarurdinAdO' (Bawwi0 2.4). upAruroda vilalApa paridevayAYcakre, anuSuSoca.

examples.text: ruroda bahuDA sItA mandaM mandasvarA satI
